name: KY-005 infrared transmitter
not_buildable: It is an infrared LED that has to be driven with a series resistor and an extra library. It is an output part, and LearnLens sketches may only switch the board's own LEDs so far.
identification: Small black PCB with 3 angled header pins at one end and a clear 5 mm LED bent flat so that it points away from the board.

facts.statement: The infrared LED has a forward voltage of 1.1 V at 20 mA and needs a series resistor (120 ohm at 3.3 V). The vendor's example uses the IRremote library.
facts.source: Joy-IT SensorKit, KY-005, technical data and code example
